standard_prerequisites.name: For a weakly etale A-algebra B the map B is flat over B tensor_A B, and flatness transfers along surjective ring maps with the module flat over the source
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides both the flatness of B -> C and the transfer to the quotient.

core_obligations: By the key lemma the map B -> C between weakly etale A-algebras is flat (proof lines 30411-30412). The ring map C tensor_A C -> C tensor_B C is surjective, hence an epimorphism of rings (proof lines 30412-30413). Since C is flat over C tensor_A C by weak etaleness of C over A, the key lemma transfers the flatness along the surjection to C being flat over C tensor_B C, which says exactly that B -> C is weakly etale (proof lines 30413-30414).
proof_roadmap: Get flatness of B -> C from the key lemma (proof lines 30411-30412).
Transfer the flatness of C over the multiplication ring along the surjection (proof lines 30412-30414).
